variables.title: Variables
variables.code:
Dim implicitlyTyped = "Text"
Const ConstantVal As Integer = 42
Dim explicitlyTyped As Integer = 10

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.code:
Dim i As Integer = 1
Dim d As Double = 1.0
Dim m As Decimal = 1.0D
Dim b As Boolean = True
Dim s As String = "Text"
Dim nullableInt As Integer? = Nothing
data_types.notes: Case-insensitive language. Primitive types alias .NET types.

operators.title: Operators
operators.code:
Dim sum = 1 + 2
Dim eq = (1 = 1)
Dim strConcat = "A" & "B"

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.code:
Dim max = If(a > b, a, b)

Select Case x
    Case 1
        msg = "One"
    Case 2 To 10
        msg = "Small"
    Case Else
        msg = "Unknown"
End Select
conditionals.notes: The 'If' operator functions like a ternary operator. 'Select Case' allows ranges.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.code:
For i As Integer = 1 To 5
Next

For Each item In collection
Next
for_loop.notes: Basic indexed 'For' and iterator 'For Each' loops.

while_loop.title: While Loop
while_loop.code:
While x > 0
    x -= 1
End While

Do While y < 10
    y += 1
Loop

functions.title: Functions
functions.code:
Function Add(a As Integer, b As Integer) As Integer
    Return a + b
End Function

Dim multiply = Function(a, b) a * b

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.notes: Arrays use parentheses for sizing and indexing.

maps.title: Dictionaries (Maps)
maps.notes: Dictionary syntax is verbose compared to C#.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.code:
Try
    Risky()
Catch ex As Exception When ex.Message.Contains("timeout")
    Fallback()
Finally
    Cleanup()
End Try
error_handling.notes: Supports structured exception handling with 'When' filters.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.code:
// Comments in Visual Basic .NET
/* Block documentation */
comments.notes: Visual Basic .NET provides comments to document code behavior.

numbers.title: Numbers & Constants
numbers.notes: Visual Basic .NET supports numeric literals for computation and indexing.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: Visual Basic .NET provides boolean conditions for program control flow.

type_casting.title: Type Conversion
type_casting.notes: Visual Basic .NET converts data between native format representations.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: Visual Basic .NET represents textual data through string literals and character arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: Visual Basic .NET formats and joins textual values for display and output.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Branching
pattern_matching.code:
case value of
    1: execute_one()
    default: execute_default()
pattern_matching.notes: Visual Basic .NET branches execution based on value comparison and conditional expressions.

range.title: Ranges & Intervals
range.notes: Visual Basic .NET defines intervals and index sequences for bounded processing.

iterators.title: Iteration & Loops
iterators.notes: Visual Basic .NET iterates across collections and sequence elements.

oop_classes.title: Structures & Modules
oop_classes.notes: Visual Basic .NET organizes data and behavior through structures or modular components.

lists.title: Collections & Arrays
lists.notes: Visual Basic .NET stores sequence data in indexed lists or arrays.

tuples.title: Records & Pairs
tuples.notes: Visual Basic .NET groups related fields into lightweight composite pairs or records.

sets.title: Sets & Uniqueness
sets.notes: Visual Basic .NET tracks unique values without duplicate entries.

modules_import.title: Libraries & Modules
modules_import.notes: Visual Basic .NET organizes external libraries and code units into modular namespaces.
